recap.paragraph: C.J. Stroud zips a 42-yard touchdown pass to Nico Collins! The Texans beat the Colts 26-3 in Houston. Stroud tossed 2 more touchdowns to Kayshon Boutte and Marlin Klein. Will Anderson Jr. sacked Daniel Jones in the end zone for a safety! David Montgomery rumbled for 107 yards. The dominant win was Houston’s first at home this season. The Texans climbed to 4-6, while the Colts fell to 3-8.
